report_or_finding: 9/11 Commission Terrorist Financing Staff Monograph — foreign-government sponsorship negative finding
employer_controller: National Commission on Terrorist Attacks Upon the United States
exact_wording: No persuasive evidence exists that al Qaeda was financially sponsored by any foreign government.
scope: Commission staff's investigation of al Qaeda financing, principally from 1998 through the post-9/11 period; this is not equivalent to a finding that no foreign-linked individual, institution, or official ever provided non-financial assistance to any hijacker.
records_reviewed: highly classified raw and finished intelligence
interviews with government officials and non-government experts
records_unavailable: The monograph states it did not attempt a comprehensive survey of every known datum or every government action concerning al Qaeda financing.
workpapers_status: Published staff monograph summarizes a broad investigation; the complete underlying classified and agency record set is not reproduced in the public monograph.
competing_findings: Other records may address logistical assistance, institutional relationships, charity oversight, or individual conduct; those propositions must not be collapsed into the narrower foreign-government financial-sponsorship finding.
notes: The monograph itself is staff work, not Commissioner-approved text. Preserve that source-class distinction whenever this negative finding is cited.
